problem:
Context: Mark Twain once listened to a pastor's speech in a church. At first he felt that the pastor was touching and prepared to donate. After ten minutes, the pastor had not finished speaking, and he became a little impatient, so he decided to donate only some change. After another ten minutes, the pastor hadn't finished speaking, so he decided not to donate a penny. The current Ice Bucket Challenge project aimed at helping patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis should also be alert to this effect due to excessive entertainment.
